newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM says H1 leak was human mailing error.
newsitem.headline: UPM says H1 leak was human mailing error.

text.p: Finnish UPM-Kymmene, Europe's largest forest industry group, said on Thursday that human error on Wednesday had caused premature distribution of its first-half interim report, but it had happened after bourse hours.
Its report was officially released on Thursday morning at 0800/0500 GMT, but daily Helsingin Sanomat published the figures before this time.
"According to the company's inquiry, a few interim reports were distributed by the post in the centre of Helsinki last night after the Helsinki Stock Exchange closed, due to a human error," UPM said.
